attchmntText: Annapurna Swadisht Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Annapurna Swadisht Limited has filed a notice with the National Stock Exchange regarding the newspaper publication of its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company published extracts of these financial results in the Financial Express and Duranta Barta on November 15, 2026. This publication was made in compliance with Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The filing was signed by Mr. Shakeel Ahmed, the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Annapurna Swadisht Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Annapurna Swadisht Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, at a Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026. The Limited Review Report was issued by Agarwal Khetan & Co., Chartered Accountants. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported Revenue from Operations of 2407363 lakhs and a Net Profit of 1660.04 lakhs. Earnings Per Share were 7.61 rupees. Total Assets stood at 62104.77 lakhs as of September 30, 2026. The financial results are available on the company website and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited website.

Annapurna Swadisht Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on October 30, 2026.
